svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Containers and Docker, slide 1. It works on my machine
svg.desc: It works on my machine: copying only the code to a server with Node 20 crashes an app built for Node 24; shipping a container that holds the app with Node 24 and its libraries gives the same result everywhere.
svg.text: Same code, different computer, different result. A container ships the code with what it needs.
